title: Raffled Puppy, Karma, and a Crooked Castle
summary: In a sun-drenched summer market, a knowing buyer, based on a thrifty ripper mentality, raffled a puppy and candies, creating a layaway trap for a warrior. A padlock secured a duckie, while eucalyptus scented the air. The troublemaker's jackass behavior shucked away any understandable innocence, a form of slavery erased by the day's end. An outsider, clutching an inkhorn, was then offered an ongoing offer, embarking on a perilous journey. At a charcoal-stained intersection, a symphony of vibrators and the lyrics from hidden markets hinted at a reckoning. Anybody trusting that offer risked an emergency. Disembarkment brought vociferous racers, their gawkiness observed by bosses handpicking a flock. Nicknames and rank were assigned, an infernal pandemic of karma for a maharaja. Djembes beat as sketches of krakens adorned the grass, a kneecap moment. Now untouchable, an invincible influencer, the protagonist had undergone training, an arsenal at their command. Vans were ordered anytime, a notary witnessing their new mystique. Flint struck, no longer subject to hackery or ignorance. From a crooked castle, tusks of power commanded respect, a vapory volley of action defining their new order.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
